applicability: The changed-intent summary of one leaf review comparison: invariant and family joint-guarantee head revisions of its before and after knowledge snapshots.
conditions: Heads are chosen by the revision comparison's head rule (revision_heads).
A relationship-only change is a successor with equal text and record status whose realizations or members differ, or an unchanged head whose realizations moved.
exclusions: Change-set line totals and subject-catalogue totals.
How an acceptance-only revision is worded in the reviewer (R35/L49).
statement: Intent count semantics: + counts invariant/guarantee revisions present only after (added or revised), - counts those retired (removed or superseded); a revision counts once on each side; realization/membership-only changes are shown in the reviewer but not in +/-; missing knowledge is shown as unavailable, never +0 -0.
